chapters.label: The one-two, live
chapters.text: Qatar, 2022. The World Cup final. France are losing, two goals to one. Kingsley Coman wins the ball, and Kylian Mbappé plays a quick one-two with Marcus Thuram... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Thuram lifts the ball over the defenders. Mbappé keeps his eyes on it, and his body over it, as it drops.

chapters.label: Two-all!
chapters.text: Right foot, first time, even as he falls! It flies past Emiliano Martínez's hand. Two-all!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep your head and body over the dropping ball, lock your ankle, and strike through the middle.
